title: atoll catalog rebuild --json
description: A new catalog from what the disks hold, the old one set aside (specs.md §9, §25). Without --yes, what it would do, done false.

set_aside.description: Where the old catalog went, <catalog>.old-<UTC time, YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>; null when there was none, or nothing was done.

ops_after.description: The highest operation id the disks' trash and tmp/ name: the new catalog's operations come after it.

disks.description: The full scan that filled the new catalog, as atoll scan --json gives each disk; empty when nothing was done.

conflicts.description: The files in conflict after it, as atoll scan --json gives them.
